Equipment
 Speed Governor of Hydraulic Turbines

This document outlines the preliminary adjustments for rotation telemetry 
 modules that have not been in service or the equipment inspection I1 to be performed 
 on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the 
 title block

The rotation telemetry module is used to provide speed indication of the turbine. 
 It has three individually adjustable output so that three separate tachometers 
 or speed indication can be used

The rotation telemetry module likewise produces a pulse on the tachometer at 
 low speed. This is used to indicate that the unit is running slowly or 
 creeping. This out put can also be used to operate a "pulsing relay"

This document initiated by eng. Mahmoud Sayed Mahmoud, tested by eng. Hassan 
 Ahmad Abou El-Haggag, accepted by eng. Selim Ahmad Aly Selim, accepted by eng. 
 Abd el-Naby Abd El-Ghany High Dam Hydraulic Power 
 Station head sector and certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC quality 
 general director & MPIS coordinator

items:
A work permit must be issued, the 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety ID category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
 protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet .... etc

Turn the transfer switch to "off" 
 position as request

Run the unit on line and loading 
 at several setting as request
Set of common and screw drivers

Turn the transfer switch to "off" position and put the rotation 
 telemetry module on an extender card, turn the transfer switch to "Gov" 
 position and reset lock-up
Run the unit at normal speed 100 RPM (spinning mode)

Adjust P-4 (calibration) on the rotation telemetry module (figure 1) to 
 obtain 6.00 volts (dc) between PIN #3 (output) and PIN # 8 (CT) (figure 2)

Adjust P-1 (TACH no 1) on the rotation telemetry module (figure 1) to obtain 
 100 RPM (50 HZ) reading on scale of the tachometer which is mounted on the 
 actuator panel

Adjust P-2 (TACH no 2) on the rotation telemetry module (figure 1) to obtain 
 100 RPM (50HZ) reading on scale of the tachometer which is mounted on the 
 cubicle panel

Shut the unit down turn the transfer switch "off" remove the rotation 
 telemetry modules from the extender card and plug into the rack turn the 
 transfer switch to "Gov" and reset the lock-up
